events.event: Menko Polkam Dudung Abdurachman said 15 personnel have died in 2026 fighting forest and land fires, after a Mi-17V5 helicopter crash in Seruyan on 4 Nov (3 TNI AD) and a Super Puma falling into the Barito River on 8 Nov.
events.key_numbers: 15 personnel dead in 2026 · 3 TNI AD killed 4 Nov (Seruyan, Central Kalimantan) · 1 killed 8 Nov (Barito Kuala, South Kalimantan)
events.why_it_matters: The human cost of this year's fires is rising even as hotspots ease.

events.event: Government said it guarantees school scholarships for children of forest-fire volunteers who died, and Minister Sugiono said the President cares about the future of the officers' families.
events.key_numbers: Statements 13-14 Nov · related to 15 fire-response deaths in 2026
events.why_it_matters: Shows what support families of fallen fire responders will actually get.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional headline list 13-14 Nov

events.event: Karangetang volcano in North Sulawesi erupted again, ejecting glowing material.
events.key_numbers: Eruption reported 13 Nov evening, alert level not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: Residents near the volcano may face evacuation and ashfall.

events.event: A crane collapsed at a hotel construction site in Mega Kuningan, South Jakarta, killing one worker, and Puslabfor Polri inspected the site on 14 Nov.
events.key_numbers: 1 worker dead · Kuningan, South Jakarta · Puslabfor on site 14 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Raises questions about construction safety oversight in Jakarta.
events.spreading_evidence: Detik indeks and CNN Indonesia both carry video of the collapse

events.event: Police said a Russian mercenary recruitment syndicate used romantic partners to recruit Indonesians, following 8 arrests in West Jakarta.
events.key_numbers: 8 suspects incl. 2 foreigners (E0814) · lovers used as recruiters
events.why_it_matters: Shows how Indonesians are lured into foreign wars.

events.event: Komnas HAM asked UGM for CCTV footage of the 10 Nov Yogyakarta demonstration, and Kompolnas said it is overseeing Polda DIY's probe into the riot, while civil coalitions in Surabaya condemned police repression.
events.key_numbers: Demo 10 Nov · Komnas HAM request 13 Nov · Kompolnas oversight 14 Nov
events.why_it_matters: A police-vs-protester case that could shape trust in policing.

events.event: DPR said funding to convert part-time PPPK teachers to full-time reaches Rp23 trillion.
events.why_it_matters: Decides the pay and job security of many honorary teachers.

events.event: A 12-car KRL train was trial-run on the Green Line on 14-15 November, and Jakarta's free private school programme was reported to be expanding.
events.why_it_matters: Longer trains mean more capacity for commuters.

events.event: Rizal Fadillah, a suspect in the Jokowi diploma case, died after ICU treatment, and Gibran's photos began to be removed from government buildings a day after his resignation.
events.key_numbers: Death 14 Nov (E0812) · MPR plenary on new VP on 2 Dec
events.why_it_matters: The vice-presidency vacancy is moving toward a candidate announcement.
events.spreading_evidence: Several top CNN Indonesia nasional headlines 14 Nov (Golkar names Puan, Bahlil)

events.event: Prabowo is expected abroad around 14-16 Nov per Yusril, so VP candidate nominations to the MPR are unlikely before the 2 Dec plenary.
events.why_it_matters: Week of 16-22 Nov is when parties lobby for the VP post.
